verdict.rationale: Anthropic publishes a public per-MTok pricing table for every current model on both the API docs and anthropic.com/pricing, with specific figures (e.g. Opus 5.5 input/output rates) visible with no sales contact required, and community discussion corroborates specific published price points (e.g. $5/$25 per MTok). Missing for 10: independent third-party audit confirming the pricing page is always fully current/comprehensive across every legacy model.
